groups.operation: Read supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT through png_read_end.
groups.condition: A PNG contains supported compressed ancillary metadata after IDAT.
groups.capability: png_read_end reaches an accepting handler that calls png_decompress_chunk.
groups.consequence: The late metadata is not decompressed.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates concern the same post-IDAT metadata path; they cite different uncertainties about reaching it.

groups.operation: Continue sequential row reading through png_read_row after png_read_update_info and png_start_read_image.
groups.condition: png_read_update_info has initialized rows before the harness calls png_start_read_image.
groups.capability: Handle the duplicate initialization report from png_app_error without preventing png_read_row; its effect may depend on PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN.
groups.consequence: The duplicate-call application error may stop valid row decoding.
groups.equivalence_reason: All three describe the same duplicate row initialization sequence and its possible effect on subsequent row reading.

groups.operation: Set up Adam7 sequential reading with png_set_interlace_handling before row initialization.
groups.condition: For an Adam7 input, the harness calls png_set_interlace_handling after png_read_update_info.
groups.capability: png_read_start_row uses the required interlace state when establishing pass and row counts.
groups.consequence: Pass or row processing may be incorrect.
groups.equivalence_reason: This concerns interlace setup, a distinct state defect.
